001package org.clafer.alloy.solve;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005import java.util.Map;
006import org.clafer.alloy.AlloyGenerator;
007import org.clafer.frontend.ModelFiles;
008import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
009
010/**
011 * The constraints of the Alloy code that an unsat core can name, as
012 * claferIG's {@code Constraints.hs} has them: the cardinalities of the
013 * clafers and the constraints of the model, each at its span in the Alloy
014 * code.
015 */
016public final class Constraints {
017
018    private Constraints() {
019    }
020
021    /**
022     * A span of the Alloy code, as an unsat core gives it: lines and columns,
023     * the end column one past Alloy's.
024     */
025    public record Range(long line, long column, long endLine, long endColumn) {
026    }
027
028    /**
029     * A cardinality, {@code upper} -1 for none.
030     */
031    public record Cardinality(long lower, long upper) {
032
033        @Override
034        public String toString() {
035            if (upper < 0) {
036                return lower == 0 ? "*" : lower == 1 ? "+" : lower + "..*";
037            }
038            if (lower == 0 && upper == 1) {
039                return "?";
040            }
041            return lower == upper ? Long.toString(lower) : lower + ".." + upper;
042        }
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * A clafer and its cardinality.
047     */
048    public record ClaferInfo(String uniqueId, Cardinality cardinality) {
049
050        @Override
051        public String toString() {
052            return uniqueId + " " + cardinality;
053        }
054    }
055
056    /**
057     * A constraint of the model: its span in the complete model, its text,
058     * and its position as shown, the file and the position in it
059     * ({@code file.cfr:3:5}), and the line in its file.
060     */
061    public record ConstraintInfo(SourceSpan pos, String syntax, String position, int fileLine) {
062
063        @Override
064        public String toString() {
065            return syntax + " (" + position + ")";
066        }
067
068        /**
069         * Whether the constraint spans the given line of its file.
070         */
071        public boolean isOnLine(long n) {
072            return fileLine <= n && n <= fileLine + pos.endLine() - pos.line();
073        }
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * A constraint: a cardinality ({@code claferInfo}) or a constraint of the
078     * model ({@code constraintInfo}).
079     */
080    public sealed interface Constraint {
081
082        Range range();
083    }
084
085    public record ExactCardinalityConstraint(Range range, ClaferInfo claferInfo) implements Constraint {
086    }
087
088    public record LowerCardinalityConstraint(Range range, ClaferInfo claferInfo) implements Constraint {
089    }
090
091    public record UpperCardinalityConstraint(Range range, ClaferInfo claferInfo) implements Constraint {
092    }
093
094    public record UserConstraint(Range range, ConstraintInfo constraintInfo) implements Constraint {
095    }
096
097    /**
098     * {@code parseConstraints}.
099     *
100     * @param clafers the name and cardinality of each clafer, by its Alloy
101     * name
102     */
103    static List<Constraint> parseConstraints(ModelFiles files, Map<String, ClaferInfo> clafers,
104            List<AlloyGenerator.Mapped> mapping) {
105        List<Constraint> out = new ArrayList<>();
106        List<String> text = text(files);
107        for (AlloyGenerator.Mapped m : mapping) {
108            Range r = new Range(m.line(), m.column(), m.endLine(), m.endColumn());
109            switch (m.kind()) {
110                case CONSTRAINT -> out.add(new UserConstraint(r, constraintInfoOf(files, text, m.span())));
111                case LOWER_CARD -> out.add(new LowerCardinalityConstraint(r, info(clafers, m.clafer())));
112                case UPPER_CARD -> out.add(new UpperCardinalityConstraint(r, info(clafers, m.clafer())));
113                case EXACT_CARD -> out.add(new ExactCardinalityConstraint(r, info(clafers, m.clafer())));
114            }
115        }
116        return out;
117    }
118
119    private static ClaferInfo info(Map<String, ClaferInfo> clafers, String clafer) {
120        ClaferInfo i = clafers.get(clafer);
121        if (i == null) {
122            throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown clafer " + clafer);
123        }
124        return i;
125    }
126
127    // the columns count a tab up to the next multiple of 8, as the compiler does
128    static List<String> text(ModelFiles files) {
129        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();
130        String all = files.text();
131        int start = 0;
132        while (start < all.length()) {
133            int end = all.indexOf('\n', start);
134            if (end < 0) {
135                end = all.length();
136            }
137            out.add(expandTabs(all.substring(start, end)));
138            start = end + 1;
139        }
140        return out;
141    }
142
143    /**
144     * The information of a constraint: its text and position in the files of
145     * the model.
146     */
147    static ConstraintInfo constraintInfoOf(ModelFiles files, List<String> text, SourceSpan s) {
148        ModelFiles.Position p = files.position(s.line());
149        String position = (p.path().isEmpty() ? "" : p.path() + ":") + p.line() + ":" + s.column();
150        String last = line(text, s.endLine());
151        String rest = drop(last, s.endColumn() - 1);
152        return new ConstraintInfo(s, closeParentheses(extract(text, s), rest), position, p.line());
153    }
154
155    private static String line(List<String> text, int l) {
156        return l - 1 < text.size() ? text.get(l - 1) : "";
157    }
158
159    private static String drop(String s, int n) {
160        return n >= s.length() ? "" : s.substring(Math.max(n, 0));
161    }
162
163    private static String take(String s, int n) {
164        return n >= s.length() ? s : s.substring(0, Math.max(n, 0));
165    }
166
167    private static String extract(List<String> text, SourceSpan s) {
168        if (s.line() == s.endLine()) {
169            return drop(take(line(text, s.line()), s.endColumn() - 1), s.column() - 1);
170        }
171        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(drop(line(text, s.line()), s.column() - 1)).append('\n');
172        for (int l = s.line() + 1; l <= s.endLine() - 1; l++) {
173            sb.append(line(text, l)).append('\n');
174        }
175        return sb.append(take(line(text, s.endLine()), s.endColumn() - 1)).append('\n').toString();
176    }
177
178    // an expression's span ends before the parentheses that close its last operand, e.g.,
179    // `initially (a --> b` of `initially (a --> b)`, which are added
180    private static String closeParentheses(String extracted, String rest) {
181        while (true) {
182            long open = extracted.chars().filter(c -> c == '(').count()
183                    - extracted.chars().filter(c -> c == ')').count();
184            int spaces = 0;
185            while (spaces < rest.length() && rest.charAt(spaces) == ' ') {
186                spaces++;
187            }
188            if (open > 0 && spaces < rest.length() && rest.charAt(spaces) == ')') {
189                extracted = extracted + rest.substring(0, spaces) + ")";
190                rest = rest.substring(spaces + 1);
191            } else {
192                return extracted;
193            }
194        }
195    }
196
197    // the line with its tabs as spaces, up to the next multiple of 8
198    private static String expandTabs(String line) {
199        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
200        for (char ch : line.toCharArray()) {
201            if (ch == '\t') {
202                int n = 8 - sb.length() % 8;
203                sb.append(" ".repeat(n));
204            } else {
205                sb.append(ch);
206            }
207        }
208        return sb.toString();
209    }
210}
